=== CONFIG

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:11 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 10 | `ENABLED_ND` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
| 9:7 | `DST_MAX_LLEN` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
| 6:4 | `SRC_MAX_LLEN` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
| 3 | `DST_REDUCE_LEN` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
| 2 | `SRC_REDUCE_LEN` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
| 1 | `DECOUPLE_RW` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
| 0 | `DECOUPLE_AW` | RW | 0x0 a| Not used
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-dma_ctrl-STATUS_0]
=== STATUS_0

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:10 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 9:0 | `BUSY` | R | 0x0 a| Status for the active stream: bits [7:0] each indicate readiness to accept another command, bit 8 is zero, and bit 9 indicates midend activity. These bits do not report backend busy or prove transfer completion; use DONE for completed transfer IDs. Unused streams read zero.
|===
